description: What became of a swap transaction: whether it is on chain and, for every DEX order it placed, whether the order is pending (waiting for the DEX batcher), complete (with the amount received and the settling transaction) or cancelled, plus the app or aggregator that placed it when known. Use it after a swap was submitted; orders normally settle within one to five minutes.

txHash.description: Hash of the transaction that placed the order: 64 hex characters.

name: get_swap_status
title: Status of a swap transaction
